sales.title: Sales
sales.empty: There are no quotations or orders yet.

record.online: This order came from an online channel, so it is not edited in sales. Its payment and refunds are managed from the payments orders list.
record.cancelHint: You can reopen it later as a draft.
record.resendHint: The customer gets a new e-mail. If they already answered, their answer and signature are removed.
record.resendAnsweredHint: The customer gets a new e-mail. Their earlier answer and signature are removed, and they must answer again.
record.sendRefused: The customer answered this quotation. Reopen it to send it again.
record.notEditable: This document cannot be edited now. A quotation is edited only while it is a draft.

form.headerHint: The customer, the salesperson, the validity date and the terms.
form.salespersonHint: Leave it empty to be the salesperson yourself.
form.validityHint: Leave it empty to use the validity in the settings.
form.termsHint: Leave them empty to use the default terms in the settings.
form.linesHint: Each product is priced from the products list. Tax and totals are calculated when you save the quotation.

payment.title: Payment to confirm
payment.hint: Ask the customer to pay before the quotation becomes an order. A new quotation starts with the default in the settings.
payment.offHint: The customer is not asked to pay. You confirm the order yourself, or their acceptance does.
payment.fullHint: The order is confirmed when the customer pays the whole amount.
payment.percentHint: The order is confirmed when the customer pays that share.
payment.shareRequired: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

errors.quantity: Enter a quantity above zero and up to 1,000,000
errors.name: Enter the text

errors.discountAboveLimit: This discount is above your limit. Ask someone who may approve it, or lower the discount.
errors.transitionForbidden: The document's current state does not allow this action. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.featureNotIncluded: The sales application is not part of your subscription.
errors.notFound: The document does not exist or you may not read it.
errors.conflict: The document changed elsewhere. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.customerEmailMissing: The customer has no email address. Add one to the customer, then send the quotation.
errors.quotationAnswered: The customer answered this quotation. Reopen it to send it again.
errors.quotationExpired: The quotation's validity date has passed. Edit the date or duplicate the quotation.
errors.linesRequired: Add at least one product line first.
errors.pdfUnavailable: The quotation PDF could not be made, so nothing was sent. Try again shortly.
errors.mailUnavailable: Outgoing mail is not set up, so nothing was sent and the quotation is unchanged. Ask your administrator to set up mail.

settings.readOnly: Sales settings are changed in the main company by someone who may manage them.

visibility.title: Who sees documents
visibility.hint: A change applies to every existing document at once. Whoever may assign salespeople always sees every document.
visibility.ownHint: Each salesperson sees their own documents and the online orders without a salesperson.
visibility.allHint: Everyone sees every document of the company; each salesperson edits only their own.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.hint: What a new quotation starts with, and the discount allowed without approval.
quotations.discountLimitHint: Zero means no limit. Applies to new and edited lines.
quotations.numberInvalid: This value was refused. Enter a whole number within the allowed range.
quotations.customerAnswerHint: What the customer may do with a quotation you send. A change applies to quotations sent from now on.

answer.noneHint: The customer reads the quotation and downloads the PDF. They cannot answer online.
answer.acceptHint: The customer accepts with one tap, or declines and may say why.
answer.accept_and_signHint: The customer writes their name and draws a signature to accept, or declines.

quotations.acceptanceConfirmsHint: When the customer accepts, the quotation becomes a confirmed order without further action. Off by default: you confirm it yourself.
quotations.signatureMethodsHint: Applies when the answer needs a signature, and to quotations sent from now on.

signature.draw_or_typeHint: The customer draws a signature or types their name, which then appears as the signature. Typing suits someone using a keyboard.
signature.drawHint: Only a hand-drawn signature is accepted. Someone who cannot draw will not be able to sign.

quotations.answeredResend: Sending again after the customer answered
quotations.answeredResendHint: What happens when you send a quotation again after the customer answered it.

resend.allowHint: The quotation is sent again and the customer's earlier answer and signature are removed.
resend.refuseHint: Reopen the quotation first, then send it again.

payment.title: Payment to confirm
payment.hint: Whether a new quotation asks the customer to pay before it becomes an order.
payment.modeHint: Each quotation keeps its own choice, so a change applies to new quotations only. You can change it on any draft.
payment.offHint: The customer is not asked to pay.
payment.fullHint: The order is confirmed when the customer pays everything.
payment.percentHint: The order is confirmed when the customer pays that share.
payment.shareHint: Used when new quotations ask for a percentage.
payment.shareInvalid: This value was refused. Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

opportunity.title: Winning an opportunity by order
opportunity.hint: When a confirmed order wins the CRM opportunity it was written from, and for what amount.
opportunity.winHint: A change applies to orders confirmed after it.
opportunity.order_confirmedHint: The opportunity is won automatically when one of its orders is confirmed.
opportunity.manualHint: Confirming an order does not change the opportunity. Its agent wins it by hand, as in a company without Sales.
opportunity.amountHint: The total of the opportunity's confirmed orders in the company currency.

modes.accept_and_sign: Accept with a signature, or decline

quote.title: Quotation {number}

invalidLink.title: This link does not work
invalidLink.body: The quotation link is wrong or no longer available. Ask the sender for a new link.

unavailable.title: The quotation could not be loaded
unavailable.body: Check your connection and try again.

acceptedConfirmed.title: You accepted this quotation
acceptedConfirmed.body: The sender has your answer and the order is confirmed.

confirmed.title: This quotation is now an order
confirmed.body: It was confirmed by the sender, so it can no longer be answered here.

cancelled.title: This quotation was cancelled
cancelled.body: The sender cancelled it. Contact them if you still need it.

expired.title: This quotation has expired
expired.body: Its validity date has passed, so it can no longer be answered. Ask the sender for a new quotation.

notOffered.title: This quotation is for reading
notOffered.body: The sender has not enabled answering online. Contact them to accept it.

quote.acceptHint: Your answer goes to the sender. You cannot change it afterwards.
quote.signatureHint: Write your name above, then draw your signature in the box with your finger or mouse, or press the Sign with my name button to use your typed name as the signature.
quote.signatureHintDraw: Write your name above, then draw your signature in the box with your finger or mouse.
quote.signatureTooLarge: The signature is too large. Clear it and draw it again.
quote.declineHint: You can tell the sender why. You cannot change your answer afterwards.

errors.failed: Your answer was not sent. Try again.
errors.answerNotAllowed: This quotation can no longer be answered here.
errors.signatureRequired: Write your name and draw your signature to accept.
errors.signatureInvalid: The signature was not accepted. Clear it and draw it again.
errors.readOnly: The sender's workspace is read-only at the moment, so your answer could not be saved. Try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

quote.heading: Quotation

payment.title: Pay to confirm
payment.hintFull: This quotation becomes an order when you pay {amount}.
payment.hintPercent: This quotation becomes an order when you pay {percent}% of the total, {amount}.

awaiting_signature.title: Sign first, then pay
awaiting_signature.body: Accept and sign this quotation above. After that you can pay {amount} to confirm it.

processing.title: Your payment is being processed
processing.body: Your order is confirmed as soon as the payment arrives.

paid.title: Payment received
paid.body: Thank you. The sender has your payment.

received.title: We received your payment
received.body: You will get the order confirmation shortly.
received.signBody: Sign the quotation above so your order can be confirmed.
received.acceptBody: We received your payment. Accept the quotation above so your order can be confirmed.

unavailable.title: Payment is not available now
unavailable.body: Contact the sender to pay for this quotation.

held.title: Payment received, order not confirmed
held.expired: The payment of {amount} arrived after the quotation expired. Reopen it, extend the validity date, send it again and confirm it, or give the money back.
held.reopened: The payment of {amount} arrived while the quotation was a draft. Send it again and confirm it, or give the money back.
held.cancelled: The payment of {amount} arrived while the quotation is cancelled, so the order will not be confirmed. Give the money back, or reopen the quotation, send it again and confirm it.
held.awaiting_signature: The payment of {amount} arrived. The order is confirmed when the customer signs the quotation.

noGateway.title: No payment gateway is ready
noGateway.body: The customer cannot pay until a payment gateway is live. Set one up in the payments settings.

attention.title: A payment needs attention
attention.payment_not_recorded: Money was received but was not recorded on the order. Check it in payments.
attention.payment_reversed: A payment that counted toward confirming the order was voided, so the order now holds less than it asked. Check it in payments.
attention.payment_awaits_confirmation: The required amount arrived and the quotation is waiting to be confirmed. Confirm the order to complete it.

refund.title: Record a refund
refund.hint: Record a refund you already made in your payment gateway's dashboard. Liwan does not send money to the customer itself.
refund.referenceHint: The refund reference as it appears in the gateway's dashboard, up to 128 characters.

errors.amount: The amount is not valid or is more than can be refunded. Enter an amount above zero, up to the amount available.
errors.reference: Enter the refund reference from the gateway, 1 to 128 characters.
errors.conflict: A payment is not recorded yet, or this same refund was already recorded. Refresh the page and check before you try again.
